QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR AI SEARCH
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
What is AI Search Optimisation?
AI Search Optimisation focuses specifically on being found and cited within AI-native search tools like Perplexity AI and ChatGPT Search — distinct from general GEO which covers all AI engines.
Is this service the same as GEO?

GEO is the broader discipline; AI Search Optimisation is a focused subset specifically for AI search engines. They share many techniques but AI Search Optimisation goes deeper on the specific platforms.
How do you measure success?
We track citation frequency, answer accuracy, click-through from AI sources, and brand sentiment in AI-generated responses.
